snippet.title: Donkey Kong Land Remake - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🚨 WARNING: This video contains flashing colors and images. 🚨

Donkey Kong Land Remake is a fanmade recreation for PC of the original Donkey Kong Land, but with looks, sound and controls in the style of DKC!
Featuring 30+ full sized levels, tight controls and a lot of secrets to uncover, so Donkey and Diddy can get all their bananas back, again!

I hope you enjoy it!

Get It Now: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bvBYmbFtw1q-0lG1tKivm3c610-pCS4P/view

You can see the kongfiguration process here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MvEXeWHxR4Y

(Also, please subscribe to this channel to get future news in case of something happens to this video.)

#DonkeyKongLandRemake #DKLR #DonkeyKongCountry #DKC #DonkeyKongLand
